research_question: Can motion-compensated local-cell support reduce false-clear versus uniform age without collapsing usable coverage?

frozen_arms.B2: global RGB-change freshness exactly as R0
frozen_arms.C1: motion-compensated local-cell support with hard invalidation

hard_rejection: projected support outside the current image
current cell newly exposed with no anchor support
local support below the frozen minimum
warp residual above the frozen maximum

mechanics_lock.cell_support_denominator: current-view valid depth pixels inside the fixed cell
mechanics_lock.out_of_frame_rule: at least 40 percent of current valid-depth pixels back-project outside the anchor image after the 2 px margin
mechanics_lock.newly_exposed_rule: supported area fraction below 0.60 after out-of-frame and occlusion rejection
mechanics_lock.occluded_rule: at least 32 projected anchor points are behind registered current depth beyond the frozen tolerance
mechanics_lock.flow_support_rule: at least 32 projected points and at least 60 percent pass forward-backward residual
mechanics_lock.warp_residual_rule: median geometry-versus-flow endpoint residual among flow-supported projected points must not exceed 3.0 px
mechanics_lock.projection: source-native depth plus intrinsics and relative ground-truth pose, current-view z-buffer

optical_flow.implementation: OpenCV Farneback full resolution grayscale in both directions

mechanics_lock.role_of_pose: offline source-native oracle mechanics only; no phone pose authority

source_lock.freshness_rule: exact sequence names must be absent from the repository evidence inventory before lock

association_and_admission.current_use: mechanics and opportunity canary only; formal effect claim is not yet admissible

analysis_rules: The mechanics completion fields, 10 Hz deterministic sampling, source-native intrinsics, depth scale, and Farneback parameters were frozen after source metadata admission but before opening RGB or depth media; the source receipt must bind the final protocol hash.
Freeze archive hashes and admission receipts before evaluation.
Do not tune thresholds, grids, features, source roster, or labels after any outcome is opened.
Report frame and event counts together; do not rescue aggregate coverage with micro averaging.
If any mechanism opportunity is absent, return NOT_EVALUABLE rather than pass.
R1-B height stratification is allowed only after R1-A passes on an admissible cohort.
